observations.title: Hierarchical deletion
observations.description: Deleting a page sends descendants to Trash, including descendants owned by others.
observations.acceptance: Test warning, child ownership, restoration scope and irreversible deletion.

observations.title: Dashboard refresh and connector access
observations.description: Dashboards refresh on open when due; live sharing can use the sharer's connector access, subject to admin policy.
observations.acceptance: Check stale/fresh/error, last refreshed, data provenance and revoked access.
observations.classification: official search excerpt; acceptance criteria not executed

observations.title: Responsive version history
observations.description: Claude Docs history overlays text when the artifact panel is too narrow; guide notes a keyboard navigation limitation.
observations.acceptance: Test overlay/side-by-side widths, focus and version restore.
observations.classification: official search excerpt; acceptance criteria not executed

observations.title: Artifact sharing and storage lifecycle
observations.description: Docs support view/comment/edit permissions; unpublishing an artifact can permanently delete associated personal/shared storage.
observations.acceptance: Test permission matrix, warning and irreversible removal.
observations.classification: official search excerpt; acceptance criteria not executed

observations.title: Approval gate
observations.description: Bot shows an approval card and waits; approvals for work started without the user can expire after about 30 minutes.
observations.acceptance: Test pending, approve, deny, expiry, notification and retry.
observations.classification: official search excerpt; acceptance criteria not executed

observations.title: Event-triggered routine
observations.description: Slack triggers can start routines as well as schedules; trigger and app access are distinct.
observations.acceptance: Test setup, trigger, pause, failed run and approval boundary.
observations.classification: official search excerpt; acceptance criteria not executed

observations.title: Persistent Canvas app data
observations.description: Canvas creates a Firestore instance when persistence is required; shared-user data can be visible via a public shared link.
observations.acceptance: Test private/shared data, reload, public-link warning and failure.
observations.classification: official search excerpt; acceptance criteria not executed
